# dracula theme inputs

Source: https://github.com/dracula/jetbrains

Commit: `718eb13e3b9879b4ed8f4a89a9eed3823c946efa`

License: MIT (`LICENSE`). Exact upstream bytes and hashes are recorded in assets.tsv.

Original author fields are preserved. If absent, use upstream vendor credit: Dracula Official.

- `themes/Dracula.theme.json`: Dracula (`dracula-dracula`); old names: Dracula
- `themes/DraculaColorful.theme.json`: Dracula Colorful (`dracula-dracula-colorful`); old names: Dracula Colorful
- `themes/DraculaAlucard.theme.json`: Alucard (`dracula-alucard`); old names: Dracula Alucard
- `themes/IslandsDracula.theme.json`: excluded — Islands variant is outside the approved classic variant set.
- `themes/IslandsDraculaColorful.theme.json`: excluded — Islands variant is outside the approved classic variant set.
- `themes/IslandsDraculaAlucard.theme.json`: excluded — Islands variant is outside the approved classic variant set.
